# Halo Meister 0.2.1

## Steam runtime-tag support

- Added support for the post-CU2 Steam build of Halo: Campaign Evolved in the
  runtime-tag tools.
- The Steam profile is protected by the exact SHA-256 of its
  `HaloSimulation_tag_release.dll`; unsupported builds remain blocked.
- Updated segmented-offset addressing for the Steam runtime layout.

Steam runtime profile research is credited to
[Zoephie](https://github.com/Zoephie) and the
[Baboon runtime poker](https://github.com/Zoephie/Baboon/blob/main/src/app/runtime_poke.rs).

**Full comparison:** [`v0.2.0...v0.2.1`](https://github.com/NicmeisteR/halo-meister/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1)
